{{Quote|Your dad was one of the best there was&mdash;I respected him because of that.|Boba Fett remembers Strom while speaking with his children|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
'''Philo Strom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the lifetime of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Strom came to be considered both honorable and among the best of his trade during his lifetime, a fact for which Fett respected him. Despite Fett's respect, the pair often did not see [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to eye, with Strom considering Fett to be scum. Strom [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], leaving behind two sons, [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom|Rolu]]. The two boys also became bounty hunters, exploiting their [[Parent/Legends|father's]] name to gain a reputation neither of them was skilled enough to uphold, resulting in every mission they took being an attempt to prove themselves as good as Strom.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Philo Strom was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] written by [[Jeremy Barlow]]<ref name="BFatSoF" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[April 27]], [[2011]] as part of the [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series.<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/16-619/Star-Wars-Adventures-Boba-Fett-and-the-Ship-of-Fear|text=Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear}}</ref>
